The workspace has no signup code, so I’ll add a standalone JavaScript function for basic email format validation.

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'import { isValidEmail } from \"./email-validator.mjs\"; for (const [input, expected] of [[\"user@example.com\", true], [\"user+tag@example.co.uk\", true], [\"\", false], [\"user@example\", false], [\"user@@example.com\", false], [\"user name@example.com\", false], [null, false]]) { if (isValidEmail(input) "'!== expected) throw new Error(`Unexpected result for ${input}`); } console.log("Email format checks passed.");'"'"
<output>
Email format checks passed.
